text: What does 7 / 2 evaluate to in Java, and why?
choices: An error, because the division is not exact
3, because both operands are int so integer division truncates
explanation: Both operands are int, so the operation is integer division and the fractional part is discarded rather than rounded — which is why -7 / 2 is -3, truncating toward zero. Make one operand floating point, as in 7 / 2.0, to get 3.5.
